name: Chosen Champion
description: (Tag:light+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are the chosen Hero of Humanity. Your Light and Holy-based abilities below Mythical rank gain a rank, your base physical abilities are massively enhanced, and all blessings on you are permanent. Divine and Clergy-aligned beings revere you and reward your service, and you gain a temporary boost to all stats when fighting to save someone, scaled to your willpower and the stakes.
